pattern.revenue: 15/15 exact. The figure that drives the P&L is sound.
pattern.cash_scan: Differs on 4 of 15 days. Cause: the form records GROSS cash then subtracts ice; Excel sometimes takes the NET figure as Cash and then derives scan = revenue - cash, overwriting the scan the staff actually wrote. Applied inconsistently - most days use gross.
pattern.rule_conflict: Deriving scan from revenue - cash is what OCR_RULES 4.1 forbids ('Never fill scan with revenue - cash and call it observed'). The form's own scan figure is observed evidence and should win.
pattern.impact: Revenue, COGS, OPEX and profit are unaffected. Only the cash-vs-scan presentation and the daily cash reconciliation are affected.
